Package qupath.ext.omero.core

Class RequestSender

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.RequestSender
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class RequestSender extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A class that sends web request and can convert HTTP responses to an understandable format (like JSON for example).

Unless stated otherwise, all requests follow HTTP redirections and use session cookies (one cookie handler per instance of this class).

Each request is performed asynchronously with CompletableFutures. They are performed on an internal pool of threads.

A request sender must be closed once no longer used.

      public CompletableFuture<Void> isLinkReachable(URI uri, RequestSender.RequestType requestType, boolean useSessionCookies, boolean followRedirection)
      Performs a request to the specified URI to determine if it is reachable and returns a 200 status code.
      Parameters:
      uri - the link of the request
      requestType - the type of request to send
      useSessionCookies - whether to use the cookies of this request sender
      followRedirection - whether to follow HTTP redirections

    • getPaginated

      public CompletableFuture<List<com.google.gson.JsonElement>> getPaginated(URI uri)
      Performs a GET request to the specified URI when the response is expected to be paginated and convert the response to JSON objects.

      If there are more results than the size of each page, subsequent requests are carried to obtain all results.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request or the conversion failed for example).

      Parameters:
      uri - the link of the request
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with a list of JSON elements

    • post

      public CompletableFuture<String> post(URI uri, byte[] body, String referer, String token)
      Performs a POST request to the specified URI.

      The body of the request uses the application/x-www-form-urlencoded content type.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      uri - the link of the request
      body - the keys and values of the request body, encoded to a byte array with the UTF 8 format.
      referer - the absolute or partial address from which a resource has been requested. It is needed for some requests
      token - the CSRF token of the session
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the raw HTTP response with the text format

    • post

      public CompletableFuture<String> post(URI uri, String fileName, String fileContent, String referer, String token, Map<String,String> parameters)
      Send a file through a POST request to the specified URI.

      The body of the request uses the multipart/form-data content type.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      uri - the link of the request
      fileName - the name of the file to send
      fileContent - the content of the file to send
      referer - the absolute or partial address from which a resource has been requested. It is needed for some requests
      token - the CSRF token of the session
      parameters - additional parameters to be included in the body of the request
      Returns:
      the raw HTTP response (that may complete exceptionally) with the text format
